{{Quote|Do you now know where you are and who you are with, Aayla Secura?''"<br />"''Returning to Coruscant aboard the ''Intrepid''.|Plo Koon and Aayla Secura|<ref name="SW36">[[Star Wars (1998) 36|''Star Wars'' (1998) 36]]</ref>}}
The '''''Intrepid''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TCC" /> luxury [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that belonged to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the final [[Standard decade|decades]] of the Republic.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars (1998) 36|''Star Wars'' (1998) 36]] takes place thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before {{Film|IV}}, which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], thirty years after [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]].</ref> the ''Intrepid'' carried Jedi Councilors [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], and Tholme's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="SW36" /> capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the Galactic Republic,<ref name="TPMn">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> from the planet<ref name="SW32">[[Star Wars (1998) 32|''Star Wars'' (1998) 32]]</ref> [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]].<ref name="SW35">[[Star Wars (1998) 35|''Star Wars'' (1998) 35]]</ref> On the journey, Koon used his [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]] to help the amnesiac Secura recover her lost memory, and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], joined by ''Intrepid'' crewmember [[Jace Dallin]], told her the story of the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], of which they all were veterans.<ref name="SW36" />
